svg.title: Figure A-1: the high-risk rows against the measures they rely on
svg.desc: A grid with the high-risk rows of the risk assessment down the side and the measures they rely on across, grouped as design, limits, safety functions and information for use; a cell is filled where the row relies on the measure, red where nothing exists today and amber where something partial exists; under each column the number of high-risk rows waiting on it.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure A-1 The high-risk rows against the measures they rely on, by what exists today

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One line per high-risk row of WP-C-03 §5; one column per measure WP-C-05 §5 allocates to any of them. A filled cell is a measure the row relies on, coloured by its §6 state.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The count under each column is how many high-risk rows wait on that measure: the columns with the highest counts are the first to build.
